# blender-recipe-decomposer (reference summary)

## Purpose
Break over-scoped Blender intent into 2-5 cohesive recipes with brief seeds, stop conditions, order, dependencies, shared assets, and handoffs.

When user intent is too big for one recipe (multiple deliverables, mixed modes, conflicting briefs), split it into smaller recipes that each fit the BlendOps recipe shape (brief → plan → assets → runtime → handoff).

## Metadata & truth boundary
- **Canonical skill:** `skills/blender-recipe-decomposer/SKILL.md`
- **Contract:** `skills/blender-recipe-decomposer/contract.json` (`v1.0.0`)
- **Category / role:** `process-discipline` / `multi-deliverable-recipe-splitter`
- **Capability tier:** `L0`
- **Truth-state policy:** Runtime status defaults to `Not Run`; Artifact status defaults to `Not Produced`; mutation rule is `downgrade_only` (never upgrade without verified evidence).

## When to use
- intent has multiple distinct deliverables (e.g., hero render + animation + GLB + variant grid)
- intent crosses multiple scene types (portrait + environment in one ask)
- previous attempts collapsed under their own scope
- before any planner runs

## Trigger cues
- "I want all of these"
- "this is a lot"
- "we'll need several outputs"
- "across these scenes"

## When not to use
- single deliverable that is already right-sized (hand off directly to intent-to-3d-brief-writer) → delegate to `intent-to-3d-brief-writer` (`references/skills/intent-to-3d-brief-writer.md`; hand off directly to intent-to-3d-brief-writer)
- pure exploration or open ideation → delegate to `blender-brainstorming` (`references/skills/blender-brainstorming.md`; use blender-brainstorming instead)
- after recipes are already split or running → delegate to `blender-scope-boundary-enforcer` (`references/skills/blender-scope-boundary-enforcer.md`; use blender-scope-boundary-enforcer for added scope or blender-stop-condition-decider to evaluate completion)

## Inputs & output/evidence contract
### Required inputs
- `multi_deliverable_request` (`string`): User request spanning multiple scenes, deliverables, or incompatible output channels
- `candidate_recipes` (`array`): Candidate BlendOps recipes or packs identified by recipe-fit-assessor

### Optional inputs
- `delivery_priority_order` (`array`): Optional user preference on which deliverable to ship first

### Primary outputs
- `ordered_sub_workflow_tracks`
- `shared_asset_and_brief_dependencies`
- `first_track_next_skill`

## Quick-start procedure
1. enumerate distinct deliverables in the user intent
2. group them into 2-5 cohesive recipes and plan shared assets early
3. give each recipe a name, one-line brief seed, one-line stop condition seed, explicit out-of-scope boundary, and handoff target
4. pin recipe start order (linear or parallel-OK) and dependencies

## Handoff notes
- **[progression]** Full brief authoring for each split recipe → `intent-to-3d-brief-writer` (`references/skills/intent-to-3d-brief-writer.md`)
- **[progression]** Pinning formal done conditions per recipe → `blender-stop-condition-decider` (`references/skills/blender-stop-condition-decider.md`)
- **[progression]** Workflow stage gates per recipe → `blender-checklist-driven-workflow` (`references/skills/blender-checklist-driven-workflow.md`)
- **[progression]** Handling scope added after splitting → `blender-scope-boundary-enforcer` (`references/skills/blender-scope-boundary-enforcer.md`)
- **[upstream_reference]** Pre-decomposition ideation when deliverables are unclear → `blender-brainstorming` (`references/skills/blender-brainstorming.md`)

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- **Runtime boundary:** Process / discipline skill — does not run Blender. Splits intent into recipe specs only.
- Run Blender, write Python, or render/export any artifacts.
- Author full 3D briefs (belongs to `intent-to-3d-brief-writer`).
- Pin formal acceptance/stop gates (belongs to `blender-stop-condition-decider`).
- Run per-recipe checklist stage gates (belongs to `blender-checklist-driven-workflow`).
- Enforce scope creep after recipes are already split (belongs to `blender-scope-boundary-enforcer`).
- Make or upgrade runtime or artifact truth claims.
